turns.question: Of the customers who signed up in August 2026, what share had bought from us by 10 October 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no metric for the share of customers who signed up in August 2026 and had bought by 10 October 2026, so I can't give that figure. The closest metrics are Signup-to-first-order rate, which counts customers whose first order came within 30 days of signing up (by signup month, the share of that cohort), and Signups, which counts new customers by signup day.
